name: Founder decision: Name the versioning authority for canon and for the operating charter, including the interim before the chef is seated
text_content:
Neither canon artifact names who may version it, though both assert that a living document changes by versioned decision and never by drift. The operating charter must state who versions it, who versions canon, and whether the chef partner holds a voice in either.

Until the chef seat is ruled on and filled, an interim authority is needed, because two equal partners cannot produce a majority.

Brandon and Dominic. The operating agreement may already bear on this and should be checked first.

Filed by Session 2. Reasoning is in sections 3 and 5 of the S2 page of the Sŏn Operating System doc 2ky45bmy-17253.
